# About Me

<img src="{{ page.profile_photo }}" class="floatpic" alt="Haoning Chen (陈浩宁)">

I am **Haoning Chen (陈浩宁)**, a master's student in **Artificial Intelligence** at **Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications (BUPT)**.

My research focuses on **egocentric vision and 3D human motion generation**, with an emphasis on **multimodal conditioning, human-scene interaction, and future motion prediction**. I am also interested in **3D vision and 3D perception**, particularly how first-person observations and scene understanding can support human motion generation.

I received my bachelor's degree in Artificial Intelligence from **China University of Petroleum, Beijing** in June 2026.

<script>
(function() {
  var timeline = document.querySelector('.timeline');
  var progress = document.getElementById('timeline-progress');
  if (!timeline || !progress) return;

  function updateProgress() {
    var rect = timeline.getBoundingClientRect();
    var height = timeline.offsetHeight;
    var visible = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (window.innerHeight - rect.top - 30) / (height - 30 + window.innerHeight * 0.4)));
    progress.style.height = visible * Math.max(0, height - 60) + 'px';
  }

  window.addEventListener('scroll', updateProgress, { passive: true });
  window.addEventListener('resize', updateProgress);
  updateProgress();
})();
</script>

## Research Interests

- Egocentric vision and 3D human motion generation
- 3D vision and 3D perception
- Multimodal conditioning
- Human-scene interaction
- Future motion prediction

I focus on **generating 3D human motion from an egocentric perspective**, exploring how multimodal conditions and scene context can support plausible human-scene interactions and the prediction of future motion.
